objective: Keep offline guide check-ins recoverable and account/tenant-bound, surface terminal failures, and make the idempotent API converge after an interrupted booking update.
current_evidence: The service worker deletes every 4xx response, including 401 and 429.
Queued records contain a stale bearer token but no user or tenant binding.
Online network/5xx fallback queues work without registering background sync.
The API returns success for a duplicate event without retrying a prior failed booking update, and ignores booking update errors.
behavior_to_preserve: Active own-tenant staff can check in guests online and offline.
Stable client_event_id prevents duplicate check-in records.
Read-only demo and foreign-tenant callers remain denied by existing server boundaries.
Existing queued work is retained; legacy unbound work is quarantined rather than silently replayed or deleted.
forbidden_behavior: Replaying one account or tenant's queued work under another active context
Persisting a bearer token on each new queue item
Treating a failed booking-state update as a completed check-in
acceptance_tests: 401 is retained, marked for reauthentication, and current auth is cleared
429/network/5xx are retained and cause retryable sync failure
Other terminal 4xx are retained with a durable failed state and visible status
Owner/tenant mismatch and legacy unbound items cause no fetch and remain quarantined
Matching work uses the current bound token and tenant header, not a queued stale token
API retries booking update after a duplicate client event and returns 5xx while convergence is incomplete
Online/offline authorized positive paths remain available
existing_customer_cases: Legacy v1 queued records remain stored and are never silently replayed under a new account.
Existing check-in client_event_id values remain the idempotency key.
rollback_strategy: A source rollback leaves the separate guide-queue-v2 database intact but pauses its replay; use a reviewed forward correction to resume it. The legacy guide-queue database remains at version 1, so old open tabs are not blocked or forced through an incompatible version downgrade.
